Bluehost 60% Off Deal: How to Get the Best Price

Published 2026-11-03 · Updated 2026-11-03 · By PrimeTech Hosting Editorial Team

Overview based on provider documentation. We have not tested this service ourselves. Prices and offers checked on November 3, 2026.

Disclosure: This page contains affiliate links. We may earn a commission if you buy through them, at no extra cost to you. Learn more.

Bluehost's pricing page shows a "Save 60%" label on its Starter plan. This guide explains what that number means, based on the page as we saw it on November 3, 2026.

Where the 60% comes from

The label appears on the Starter plan on the 36-month term. Bluehost shows $3.99 per month, renewing at $9.99 per month. The saving is measured against that renewal price: $3.99 is 60% less than $9.99. The other shared plans show smaller savings.

PlanPromo price (36 months)LabelRenews at
Starter$3.99/moSave 60%$9.99/mo
Business$6.99/moSave 50%$13.99/mo
eCommerce Essentials$14.99/moSave 32%$21.99/mo

How to get that price

On the pricing page, pick the 36-month term and choose Starter. The page we viewed did not ask for a coupon code. If a coupon field or a different price appears at checkout, trust what the checkout shows.

What the 60% does not mean

  • It is not a discount on your renewal. Bluehost says promotional prices are valid for the initial term only.
  • It is not available on every term. The price changes if you choose 12 months.
  • It does not include taxes, which the pricing page says are not included.

Is it the best price?

It is the lowest monthly price on the page, but you commit for 36 months, and the renewal price is about two and a half times higher. Work out what you will pay over your real timeline with our renewal cost guide, and read the Bluehost review for plan limits. Starter has no phone support. Current offers are on the Bluehost pricing page.

Frequently Asked Questions

Bluehost's pricing page shows a Save 60% label on Starter at the 36-month term, as of November 3, 2026. It is a comparison with the renewal price.

The pricing page we viewed did not require one. See our coupon guide for how Bluehost offers are applied.
